sources.note: Only the introduction (p. 157) was readable via the Persée record page; it names Coroado, Purí and Koropó as the three members of the family and gives locations. The PDF (docAsPDF) is behind an altcha challenge that automated download/direct download could not pass (not reachable by automated download), so the comparative wordlists and any phonetic remarks could not be checked.

sources.citation: Martius, Carl Friedrich Philipp von. 1867. Glossaria linguarum Brasiliensium / Wörtersammlung brasilianischer Sprachen (Beiträge zur Ethnographie und Sprachenkunde Amerika's zumal Brasiliens, II). Leipzig: Friedrich Fleischer. Coropó list pp. 167-169.

sources.citation: Nikulin, Andrey. 2020. Proto-Macro-Jê: um estudo reconstrutivo. Doctoral dissertation, Universidade de Brasília.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Koropó stress. Koropó is treated only in the classification overview (pp. 19-20): sources are Eschwege (1818, v.1, pp. 165-171) and Schott (1822, pp. 48-51), Martius (1867) copied Eschwege; Koropó is explicitly omitted from the phonological comparison 'em razão da escassez de dados disponíveis' (p. 94).

sources.citation: Ramirez, Henri, Valdir Vegini & Maria Cristina Victorino de França. 2015. Koropó, puri, kamakã e outras línguas do Leste brasileiro: revisão e proposta de nova classificação. LIAMES 15(2): 223-277. DOI 10.20396/liames.v15i2.8642302
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Koropó section (pp. 224-236) is a lexical comparison of the two surviving wordlists (Eschwege 1815, Schott 1818) with Purí-Coroado and Maxakalí; the only remark on accents (p. 237, about the Purí/Coroado lists) is that 'O uso de acentos e outros diacríticos (V̀, V́, V̂, V̈, Vh) não vem acompanhado da devida explicação sobre os seus significados' and that no phonological rules can be deduced from the material.

sources.citation: Silva Neto, Ambrósio Pereira da. 2007. Revisão da classificação da família lingüística Purí. MA thesis, Universidade de Brasília (Glottolog: 'Revisão da Família Lingüística Purí')
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: The only modern work devoted to the Purí family incl. Koropó; may contain a philological reinterpretation of the wordlists' diacritics (e.g. whether Eschwege's acutes mark stress). Unlikely to state a rule, but it is the one unread candidate.

sources.citation: Eschwege, Wilhelm Ludwig von. 1818. Journal von Brasilien, oder vermischte Nachrichten aus Brasilien, auf wissenschaftlichen Reisen gesammelt. Erstes Heft. Weimar: Landes-Industrie-Comptoir. (Koropó wordlist, 'Sprachproben der Coroatos, Coropos und Puris, nach Teutschem Ohr', ch. 9, pp. ~165-171)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No statement about accent. Preface to the list only says the words can seldom be written correctly 'denn verschieden klingen oft die Töne, nicht nur von verschiedenen Personen ausgesprochen, als auch von verschiedenen Ohren gehört'. Some Koropó forms carry acute accents (Mekéchambe, Memmptä, Boarké, Schaperré) with no explanation of what they mark.
